component.name: MeshCore
component.summary: Chat over MeshCore LoRa companion radios

description.p: A small, fast native desktop client for MeshCore companion radios. It connects over USB serial or Bluetooth LE and lets you chat on channels and with contacts across an off-grid LoRa mesh.

ul.li: Direct messages with delivery confirmation and automatic retries
Room servers, and repeater administration (status, telemetry, remote CLI, trace route)
Contact management, sharing links and blocking

description.p: Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux; right-click menus; blocking; app icon.
